design_philosophy: A soft, tactile, inviting workspace. Instead of stark sterile metrics, we want a 'living' app feeling. The gamified plant growth widget drives an earthy, organic visual style.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing: use 2-3x more padding. Elements need room to breathe, simulating a clean desk.
spacing_and_layout.grid_mode: Mode B (Control Room) with wider gaps. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4, gap-6 or gap-8.

surface_strategies.cards: Flat background (Pure White), 1px subtle warm border (#E6DFD4), no heavy shadows by default. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1), shadow-lg, border darkens.
surface_strategies.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl, bg-[#F9F8F6]/80, 1px bottom border border-white/40.
surface_strategies.buttons: Tactile Neumorphism: Solid primary background, sharp 1px inner border, soft colored shadow for depth.

components_instructions.shadcn_customization: Strip generic Vercel borders. Apply our warm border color (#E6DFD4) and generous rounded corners (rounded-2xl).
components_instructions.habit_toggles: Instead of small checkboxes, use large clickable surface cards that fill with the success color (#F0F4F1) and display a success checkmark when active.
components_instructions.heatmap: Consistency heatmap should use organic, rounded squares (rounded-md) in varying opacities of the success color (#6B8E78).
components_instructions.plant_widget: Use an earthy podium style frame. Prominently display the plant image URL based on level.
components_instructions.timer: Display with large, clean typographic numbers. Use primary color (#C86B53) for the active timer ring.
components_instructions.test_attributes: Add data-testid to all interactable elements (e.g., data-testid='habit-toggle-btn').

hero.description: Morning routine hero, aesthetic ceramic mug and notebook.
hero.usage: Use as main hero graphic on the landing page/auth page.

background_pattern.usage: Use as a subtle background layer for the Reward Shop or Analytics section.

plant_level.description: 3D claymation monstera plant on sage podium.
plant_level.usage: Use in the Plant Growth Gamification Widget on the dashboard.

reward_item.usage: Use in the Reward Shop as an unlockable item.

macro_leaf_1.usage: Decorative usage on leveling up screens or streak milestones.

macro_leaf_2.usage: Secondary decorative usage for auth page background subtly blended.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a full-stack React+FastAPI app. Use the defined JSON theme for Tailwind config. Ensure all headings use 'Outfit' and body uses 'Manrope'. All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes. Do NOT use generic blue colors. Implement 'lucide-react' for icons with a stroke width of 1.5. Utilize the image URLs provided in their specific places to avoid placeholder text. Follow mobile-first spacing with ample breathing room (e.g., p-6 or p-8 inside cards).
